bullets.text: UK MNOs Eye mmWave Spectrum – but Challenges Loom – Ofcom approves auction for mmWave spectrum, but deployment costs and range issues persist.
VMO2 Launches Giga Sites – First Giga Site in London boosts 5G with Nokia's MIMO tech for enhanced connectivity.
Boldyn Expands Private Networks – New projects in London and New York enhance urban connectivity and smart city initiatives.
Airbus Chooses Ericsson for 5G – Private 5G network to enhance smart factory operations in Hamburg and Toulouse.
Device Intelligence Crucial for Private Networks – GSMA's tools enhance security and performance in growing private network deployments.
Verizon Appoints New CEO – Daniel Schulman takes over from Hans Vestberg to redefine Verizon's market strategy.
China Tightens Telecom Supplier Regulations – New scrutiny on Nokia and Ericsson impacts their market share in China.
Meta Expands APAC Subsea Cable Network – New projects aim to boost connectivity and support rising digital service demands.
